# awscc_ssm_service_setting (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SSM::ServiceSetting. ServiceSetting is an account-level setting for an AWS service that defines how a user interacts with or uses a service or feature.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `setting_id` (String) The ID of the service setting, such as /ssm/parameter-store/high-throughput-enabled.
- `setting_value` (String) The value of the service setting.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the service setting.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_date` (String) The last time the service setting was modified.
- `last_modified_user` (String) The ARN of the last modified user.
- `status` (String) The status of the service setting. The value can be Default, Customized or PendingUpdate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_service_setting.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the service setting

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_service_setting.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ssm_service_setting.example "arn"
```
